title: Generator output (LLM call #2)
description: Structured output of the message generator. The policy (code) has already chosen the move and the target goal; the generator only phrases ONE message. Code then verifies: move equals the requested move; target_slot_ids is a subset of the requested goal's slots; the output check passes (question count measured by code, not trusted from question_count; length; forbidden terms; URLs/phones allowlist; Latin ratio). On failure: one retry with the failure codes, then the goal's fixed template. Same wire-schema derivation rules as the extractor.

message.description: Hebrew, gender-neutral, plain text (no markup, no links, no phone numbers). For move=summary: the warm summary paragraph that surrounds the fixed outcome text.

target_slot_ids.description: Slots this message asks about. Becomes last_assistant.asked_slot_ids (gates bare yes/no answers next turn).

summary_points.description: Only for move=summary (else null): the points the summary paragraph covers, each tied to filled slots, so code can verify the summary only mentions recorded facts.
